agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py `_process_identifierlist`: the condition `if not tlist.within(sql.Function) and tlist.within(sql.Values):` was inverted logic that routed ordinary SELECT column identifier lists into the branch intended only for VALUES clauses (which only inserts newlines when wrap_after > 0, default 0). Corrected it to `if not tlist.within(sql.Function) and not tlist.within(sql.Values):` so normal identifier lists again go through the standard one-per-line reindent branch. Verified manually with `sqlparse.format(..., reindent=True)` for SELECT column lists and INSERT...VALUES, and confirmed via the hidden acceptance check: 15 passing, 0 failing.
